occupations.title: Sales Managers
occupations.rationale: The software is explicitly used by Sales Managers to monitor team performance, set goals, forecast revenue, and track sales metrics, as evidenced by a testimonial from a "Sales Manager" and features like "team monitoring" and "advanced sales metrics tools" [D:Pipedrive:landing:2, D:Pipedrive:landing:5].

occupations.title: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
occupations.rationale: The product is designed for salespeople to manage their daily work, as it helps them "track your sales pipeline, optimize leads, manage deals with AI and automate your entire sales process so you can focus on selling" [D:Pipedrive:landing:1, D:Pipedrive:landing:5].

occupations.title: Chief Executives
occupations.rationale: Testimonials from a "CEO and Founder" and "Managing Director" indicate that business leaders use the software to "harness sales insights to drive your strategy" and ensure "predictable revenue" by using its forecasting and reporting features [D:Pipedrive:landing:2, D:Pipedrive:landing:4].
